task: Implement a bounded repository change and verify it end to end.
context: Each worker gets an APXM-owned detached Git worktree. Replace profile names with resolvable APXM ACP profiles in this runtime.
trigger: goal-loop policy admitted one bounded ACP worker pass

workers.role: Produce the concrete implementation plan and risks.
workers.prompt: Plan the change. Do not edit files. Return exact files, tests, and constraints.

workers.role: Implement the accepted bounded change in your own worktree.
workers.prompt: Implement the change in your assigned worktree. Return changed files and tests run.

workers.role: Critique the implementation and preserve dissent.
workers.prompt: Review the change for correctness, policy risk, missing evidence, and regressions.

workers.role: Verify behavior independently in your own worktree.
workers.prompt: Run focused checks and report evidence, blockers, and follow-up recommendations.

supervisor.prompt: Evaluate worker outputs, decide pass/needs_more/blocked/unsafe, and emit feedback for another bounded pass only when required.
